description: Independent Astra and Claude bilingual editions, with Sol research and separate review.

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review follows MIT’s November 19,2026 report and NIH ultrasound background. Nine-day imaging was a synthetic phantom test; the ten-minute chest sweat test and thirty-minute neck-patch cycling demonstration were separate. The cycling patch connected to a portable tablet. These results support a materials advance; clinical effectiveness, longer human use and production outcomes were not independently verified. The full Science paper was inaccessible; MIT’s labelled repository link resolved to an unrelated thesis and was excluded.

articles.availability_note: 来源核查依据MIT于2026年11月19日的报道及NIH超声背景资料。九天成像属于合成模型测试；十分钟胸部汗液测试、三十分钟颈部贴片骑行展示分别进行，骑行贴片连接便携平板。这些结果支持材料进展，临床效果、长期人体使用及量产成效未获独立核实。Science全文未能访问；MIT标注的仓储链接跳转至无关论文，已排除。
